description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, handling user interactions on the main screen and providing a sharing feature via intents.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that presents a screen with a text input and a share button, enabling users to share text via an intent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, toolbar, and click listener for the share button.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Creates and launches a share intent with the text input's content.
